 Advertisement Updated: 5:49 AM EDT Oct 20, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Sean Kelly Video: Sunny, but breezy day ahead
 Updated: 5:49 AM EDT Oct 20, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Sean Kelly BOSTON — Tuesday brings gusty winds with partly sunny skies to the Boston area, followed by more sun and clouds with gusty winds Wednesday. 
 Thursday stays breezy with some clouds before pleasant weather arrives Friday. 
 Advertisement The weekend turns cooler Saturday, then Sunday is sunny, with a milder Monday to round out the forecast for Massachusetts.
 StormTeam 5 tools: Radar | Map Room | Alerts | Futurecast 
 StormTeam 5's 7-day forecast:
 Tuesday: Partly sunny with gusty winds. High of 61.
 Wednesday: Sun and clouds with gusty winds. High of 56.
 Thursday: Some clouds and breezy. High of 62.
 Friday: Pleasant with mostly sunny skies. High of 56.
 Saturday: Cool with partly sunny skies. High of 57.
 Sunday: Sunny. High of 63.
 Monday: Milder with partly sunny skies. High of 68.
